notes: Long per-narrator dossiers plus verbatim document quotes and a dense chronology: the pipette arithmetic chain, dated events and the three rival explanations are nearly complete, while custody chains, secondary biographical dates, and the single-farm money computation are thin, and it hard-asserts several unsettleable or wrong values (Selby as nephew, Article VII 1892, station gain invented 1905, five dozen pipettes, weigh book from 1898).
